general_policy_context.evidence: Current SAFRA By-Laws §6.4 says, “Where applicable,” members sign guests in and guests should be accompanied. SAFRA FAQ describes member/family/friends access for most SAFRA-managed facilities. This does not expressly decide whether the dining tenants in this screen are gated or open for independent public entry. No blanket exclusion inference made.
